identity.archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Adapted for Medical Admin)
identity.rationale: Medical scheduling requires absolute clarity, density, and functional authority. We avoid 'fintech dark mode' or generic 'SaaS blue'. The UI is strictly monochromatic to allow the constraint violation colors (Red/Yellow/Green) to command full attention. The aesthetic is clean, trustworthy, and heavily optimized for data density on mobile screens.

typography.rationale: Both Fira Sans and IBM Plex Sans have exceptional Greek character support. Fira provides an authoritative, clean heading structure, while IBM Plex shines in dense, tabular data layouts like calendars.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Mobile-first, dense but breathable. Utilize negative space aggressively outside the calendar, but pack the calendar grid tightly to minimize scroll fatigue.

calendar_grid.mobile: Horizontal scroll container (overflow-x-auto, snap-x snap-mandatory) displaying 7 consecutive days (Sun-Sat). Columns must be fixed width (min-w-[120px]) to ensure legibility.
calendar_grid.desktop: Standard 7-column CSS grid (grid-cols-7) utilizing full width.

login_screen.layout: Full height, split layout on desktop, stacked on mobile.
login_screen.visuals: Use login_bg image as an edge-to-edge background with a heavy white glassmorphism overlay (backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/80) for the form container.
login_screen.elements: Minimalist input fields (border-b only, no full outline), prominent black CTA button.

dashboard.card_style: Cardless design. Use 1px border (border-border), no shadows. Hover state: subtle background tint (bg-gray-50), not a lift.
dashboard.action: Massive, high-contrast 'New Schedule' (Νέο Πρόγραμμα) CTA at the top.

doctor_management.layout: Dense list. Avatar/Initial on left, name and stats on right.
doctor_management.actions: Swipe-to-delete or explicit trailing action icons (Trash/Edit).

setup_wizard.navigation: Sticky bottom bar with 'Next' (Επόμενο) and 'Back' (Πίσω) buttons to ensure easy thumb reach on mobile.

calendar_grid_edit_view.cell_design: Border-collapse style (1px border-border on right and bottom). Each day cell shows date, hospital status (Open/Closed), and assigned doctor.
calendar_grid_edit_view.status_indicators: Violations MUST be visible via background color AND an icon/shape for accessibility (e.g., Red bg + Cross icon for Hard Violation).
calendar_grid_edit_view.interaction: Tap day cell -> triggers Bottom Sheet.

day_edit_bottom_sheet.mobile_behavior: Fixed to bottom, slides up (framer-motion or CSS transform).
day_edit_bottom_sheet.desktop_behavior: Acts as a side-panel (drawer) sliding in from the right.
day_edit_bottom_sheet.content: List of available doctors. Greys out or heavily flags doctors who would trigger a violation if selected.

summary_panel.mobile: Expandable sticky bar at the bottom, just above the main actions.
summary_panel.desktop: Persistent right-side rail (col-span-1 in a 4-col layout).

motion_and_interaction.hover: Background tinting (bg-gray-50) over scaling. Keep it grounded.
motion_and_interaction.transitions: Fast and snappy (duration-150 ease-out). Medical software should feel instantly responsive, not floaty.
motion_and_interaction.bottom_sheet: Spring physics for the drag/swipe to close interaction (duration-300 ease-spring).

accessibility_and_testing.colorblind_safe: Never rely solely on color for violations. Red MUST be paired with a warning icon; Green with a checkmark.
accessibility_and_testing.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all interactive elements (dates, buttons, toggles) for mobile usability.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY on all buttons, calendar cells, and inputs (e.g., data-testid='doctor-select-btn', data-testid='calendar-cell-15').

image_urls.description: Minimalist modern logo for the app
Abstract minimalist architectural background for login screen

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML/Tailwind for structural layouts instead of heavily relying on nested Shadcn layout wrappers to ensure mobile fluidity.
Implement the calendar strictly as a grid with mobile horizontal scrolling (snap points) to maintain the Sun-Sat structure.
Greek UI Text implies the charset must be UTF-8 and typography must be Fira Sans & IBM Plex Sans.
Ensure the PDF export feature formats exactly to A4 landscape layout. Use print-specific CSS media queries or a dedicated library.
Include 'data-testid' on every actionable element, as specified in the accessibility rules.
